name: Betel Leaf Image Dataset from Bangladesh
description: The Betel Leaf Image Dataset from Bangladesh is an agricultural computer vision collection containing 3,589 images of betel leaves (Piper betle L.) captured in Camperhat, Raipur, Lakshmipur, Bangladesh. The dataset categorizes betel leaves into four distinct physiological conditions: healthy leaves, dried leaves, leaves afflicted with bacterial disease, and leaves exhibiting fungal brown spot disease. The collection is partitioned into an Original folder containing 1,000 balanced field-captured images (250 images per class) and an Augmented folder comprising 2,589 images structured into training (2,388 images) and testing (201 images) subsets for machine learning and deep learning benchmarking.
